en: Dependent on a state that is neither-afflictive nor with-outflows (*anāraṇa-anāsava*), a state that is with-affliction and with-outflows (*saraṇa-sāsava*) arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
(Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-afflictive nor a fetter (*anāraṇa-asaññojana*), a state that is with-affliction and a fetter (*saraṇa-saññojana*) arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. One under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is not a fetter (*na-āraṇa*) and not a tie (*na-gantha*), a state that is a refuge (*saraṇa*) and a tie arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated.
One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance (*avigata*).
Dependent on a state that is neither a flood (*na-oṣa*) nor a bond (*na-yoga*), a state that is a refuge and a flood arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition: one [formula] … pe … in the case of non-disappearance: one.
Dependent on a state that is not a fetter and not a bond, a state that is a fetter and a bond arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition:
one … pe … in the case of non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on a state that is not-conflicting (*anāraṇa*) and not-an-obstacle (*anīvaraṇa*), a state that is conflicting (*saraṇa*) and an obstacle (*nīvaraṇa*) arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated.
[Under] root [condition], one; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance condition, one.
Dependent on a state that is not-conflicting and not-a-grasping (*aparāmāsa*), a state that is conflicting and a grasping (*parāmāsa*) arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the condition of root (hetu), one [formula] …pe… under the condition of non-disappearance (avigata), one.
